replies.author: Dioclashroyale
replies.body:
I'm more a developer, not good at all with commercialization and presentation. 

I just wanted to present what's the limit of AI at the moment, since its fully though and coded by AI, i tested every step and gave advices as a tester, but they all did it. 

Did also a phew other games with it, i would publish all of them if it wasnt for 100$ fee on steam every game you pubblish.

So i decided to pubblish one and see how it goes, and then decide if its worth to pubblish the others. 

but in general it was a very cool experience.

replies.author: Dioclashroyale
replies.body:
like when you signin somewhere and you insert your password. Then it say ERROR "You need atleast 1 uppercase letter" and you have to change it. this is the game, 40 rules that you have to overcome with logic to build the password, (15 in the demo) with increasing difficulty.

Try the demo if you like, i had fun playing with my friend, that's why i decided to pubblish it on steam.
